cases.name: unchanged
cases.description: A second identical invocation preserves diagnostics and checked obligations with zero function analyses.

cases.name: unrelated
cases.description: An unrelated inferred function update preserves a contextual result and its nested dependencies.

cases.name: callee-release
cases.description: Changing a read-only helper to release its argument invalidates callers using the old summary.

cases.name: callee-initialization
cases.description: Removing a callee output write invalidates callers depending on its initialized postcondition.

cases.name: missing-definition
cases.description: A missing direct or indirect definition becoming available invalidates the old boundary.

cases.name: callback
cases.description: Changing a callback global target invalidates its readers and nested contextual callers.

cases.name: global-facts
cases.description: Count and sized-field witnesses or refutations invalidate dependent contexts.

cases.name: header
cases.description: Changed header contents with restored timestamps invalidate persistent reuse.

cases.name: conditional-include
cases.description: A newly available __has_include target changes the preprocessing identity even without inclusion.

cases.name: options
cases.description: Selection, macro, target, diagnostic and compiler option changes do not reuse incompatible results.

cases.name: cache-corruption
cases.description: Truncated or corrupt persistent records cannot produce successful checking.

cases.name: cache-unavailable
cases.description: An unavailable cache directory preserves uncached checking behavior.

cases.name: stale-object
cases.description: A warm link cache cannot establish a stale compiler object after its source changes.

cases.name: explanations
cases.description: Compact and expanded reports retain every distinct source obligation, trust and selected outcome.

cases.name: recursive
cases.description: Repeated call provenance cannot establish new facts or turn a limit into success.

cases.name: transport
cases.description: Inline, helper, whole-program and compiler-object cases preserve positive and negative results.

cases.name: leaf-edit
cases.description: A changed leaf unit invalidates dependent results while an independent unit remains reusable.
